description: Defines a simple helper object for localStorage operations with namespacing, including get, set, remove methods, and a helper to retrieve the namespace key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an item from local storage under the specified key and parses it as JSON; returns fallback on failure or if item is not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in local storage under the specified key after serializing it as JSON, ignores errors.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from local storage for the specified key, ignores errors.

methods.name: nsKey
methods.description: Returns the namespace string used for local storage keys.
